gui.skyblock_translator.title: §b§lSkyBlock Translator Settings
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.main.tooltip: Core mod settings, API keys and GitHub settings
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.enabled.desc: [Recommended / Stable] Globally enables or disables all translation features.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.disable_on_s: [Recommended / Stable] Temporarily disables all translation features while holding Shift to quickly inspect the original text.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.regex_transl: [Recommended / High Performance] Use regular expressions from the local dictionary for instant offline translation without querying the API.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.key_settings: [Stable] Hotkey to open the mod's configuration GUI.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.key_toggle.d: [Stable] Hotkey to quickly enable or disable all translator functions in-game.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.provider.des: [Stable] Choose translation service. Google Free is free. DeepL and Yandex require an API key, but offer better translation quality.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.showkey.desc: [Stable] Whether to reveal the characters in the API key field.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.key.desc: [Stable] API key for the selected paid provider.
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.chat.tooltip: Settings for translating chat messages and outgoing text
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.translate_ch: [Recommended / Stable] Enables or disables translation of messages in chat.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.translate_np: [Recommended / Stable] Translates messages from non-player characters in chat.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.chat_display:
[Recommended / Stable] How to display translated text in chat:
- Separate Line: Prints translation as a new line below (recommended, preserves clickable links/names of the original).
- Append Below: Appends translation below the original message.
- Inline: Appends translation in parentheses after the original.
- Replace Original: Fully replaces the original text with translation.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.hover_origin: [Recommended / Stable] Displays the original English message in a tooltip when hovering over translated chat text.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.outgoing.des: [Experimental / Use with care] Automatically translates your messages from Russian to English before sending them to the chat.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.guild_chat.d: [Stable] Whether to translate messages in guild and officer chats.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.party_chat.d: [Stable] Whether to translate messages in party chat.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.coop_chat.de: [Stable] Whether to translate messages in co-op chat.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.dm_chat.desc: [Stable] Whether to translate incoming private messages.
[Stable] Whether to translate general player chat in lobby/world.
[Recommended / Stable] Whether to translate server system messages.
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.world.toolti: Settings for translating entities and texts in the world
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.holograms.de: [Stable / Recommended] Enables translation of floating 3D texts and holograms.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.mobs.desc: [Not Recommended / High API Spam] Enables translation of health/level tags above mobs. May cause micro-stutters during mob spawn.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.npc_names.de: [Not Recommended / API Spam] Enables translation of friendly NPC names.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.translate_ta: [Recommended / Stable] Enables translation of statistics and server info in the player list (Tab). Recommended to use with Offline Regex.
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.gui.tooltip: Settings for translating GUI elements and items
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.tooltips.des: [Recommended / Stable] Enables translation of item descriptions in inventories.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.item_names.d: [Not Recommended / High API Spam] Enables translation of item names. Makes it harder to search items on the Auction House.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.enchantments: [Not Recommended / API Spam] Enables translation of enchantment names on items and books.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.translate_en: [Recommended / Stable] Translates descriptive text of what enchantments do, keeping enchantment names in English.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.translate_ab: [Not Recommended / API Spam] Enables translation of item ability titles and names.
[Recommended / Stable] Enables translation of detailed descriptions and effects of item abilities.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.translate_ra: [Recommended / Stable] Enables translation of the item rarity line at the bottom of tooltips (e.g. LEGENDARY SWORD -> ЛЕГЕНДАРНЫЙ МЕЧ).
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.titles.desc: [Recommended / Stable] Enables translation of container/menu titles.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.scoreboard.d: [Recommended / Stable] Enables translation of scoreboard sidebar lines. Fully compatible with offline regex.
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.filters.tool: Settings for ignoring and filtering technical text
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_coold: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore ability cooldowns and recharge messages in chat.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_damag: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore floating damage indicator tags.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_prefi: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore prefix lines from other mods (e.g. NEU:, Skytils:).
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_dunge: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore dungeon floor completion, milestones, and clearing stats.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_slaye: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore spawn and death notifications for Slayer bosses.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_lobby: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore system notifications about players joining or leaving.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_bazaa: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore item price evaluations and auction/bazaar rates.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_uuids: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore lines containing unique IDs, profile IDs, coop IDs, and UUIDs.
[Recommended / Stable] Ignore hyperlinks and server IP addresses.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.ignore_dates: [Recommended / Stable] Ignore timestamps, dates, and technical lobby names.
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.cache.toolti: Clear cache, reset settings, and support
[Stable] Deletes the saved local translation cache from disk.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.reload.desc: [Stable] Reloads the configuration file and user dictionary from disk.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.report.desc: [Stable] Open the GitHub repository to report mod code bugs or crashes.
gui.skyblock_translator.opt.suggest_tran: [Stable] Open the dictionary GitHub repository to suggest new word translations.
gui.skyblock_translator.cat.language.too: Choose the target language for in-game translations
